name: hikoutei
description: Typed repository and safe write layer for Google Sheets-backed MVPs. SQLite-authoritative entity lifecycle with asynchronous Google Sheets projection.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @hikoutei/ikisaki && npm run build -w @hikoutei/contracts && npm run clean && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node scripts/ci/reconcile-contracts-dist.mjs && npm run build -w spreadsheet-db-mcp
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @hikoutei/ikisaki && npm run build -w @hikoutei/contracts && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json
scripts.typecheck:test: npm run build -w @hikoutei/ikisaki && npm run build -w @hikoutei/contracts && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p packages/ikisaki/tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p packages/mcp/tsconfig.test.json
scripts.test: npm run build -w @hikoutei/ikisaki && npm run build -w @hikoutei/contracts && vitest run
scripts.audit:deps: depcruise src --config .dependency-cruiser.cjs --output-type err || node -e "console.error('[audit:deps] report-only: P8-A baseline phase — violations are recorded, not gated (see .dependency-cruiser.cjs header); hard-fail arrives in P8-C.')"

npx depcruise src packages/hikoutei-contracts --config .dependency-cruiser.cjs --output-type err || node -e "console.error('[audit:deps] report-only: violations above are the P8-A/P8-B baseline; hard gate lands in P8-C')"
